Configuration for pre-commit hooks to check file formats, run linters, and execute tests.

# Purpose
The `.pre-commit-config.yaml` file configures pre-commit hooks for a software project. It specifies repositories and hooks that are used to enforce code quality checks before committing changes to the version control system. The configuration includes hooks for checking large files, validating `TOML` and `YAML` files, fixing end-of-file issues, and removing trailing whitespace. It also integrates the `ruff` linter and formatter, and includes local hooks for propagating dependency updates and running unit tests with `pytest`. The file uses the `exclude` directive to ignore specific paths, ensuring that certain files or directories are not processed by the hooks.
